description: Call this when a user asks for a meal plan or for what to eat over a number of days. Builds a plan of 1 to 7 days from Foodbe's recipes, within an optional dollar budget for the whole plan, filtered by the diet and allergies you send. Returns outcome "served" with the plan and its insight: the taste the plan is missing, the food group it is short on, the health roles it covers, and its cheapest, priciest and quickest meal. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model. If no plan can be built, it returns outcome "not_found" and costs nothing. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

allergies.description: Optional allergens to leave out, for example Peanuts.

budget.description: Optional most the whole plan may cost, in US dollars.

days.description: Optional number of days, from 1 to 7.

diet.description: Optional diet to filter by, for example Vegan.

name: foodbe_meal_plan
